documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Ltd reported a revenue of over 700 crores and achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% in Q1 FY27. The company experienced trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May, but operations normalized in June. Management proposed 40 crores of capex over the next two years and is planning a corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into Tieramet Limited. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with revenues from operations at Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and PAT at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an export contribution of between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to end the year with a value-added product share of around 63% to 64%.
guidance.quote: But we will be ending this year at around 63-64%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next three to four years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase the share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May, but everything normalized from June.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we had the disruption in April and May. Obviously, we took some advantage by increasing our margins in the first two months, and from the month of June, everything seems to have normalized.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees a lot of demand, with existing customers looking to increase volumes and double capacity in the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has expanded its export portfolio, exporting over 100 tons of bus bars to North America last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to reach 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Copper demand growth will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed 40 crores of capex over the next two years, covering FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects its 10,000-ton capacity expansion to become operational between April and June of the next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to form a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited to hold its copper infrastructure and businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest 40 crores over the next two years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into a plastic recycling project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved a revenue of over 700 crores. We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons. We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company was able to increase its margins across the board due to a shortage created by disruptions in April and May.
margins_costs.quote: It was because of the shortage which was there in April and May, which was due to the disruptions in the market.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins are more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms because purchases and sales are linked to LME.
margins_costs.quote: So, our margins are going to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.

margins_costs.claim: The removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, has helped the company increase its margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year was around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA of around 62 rupees per kg in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Silver and tin-coated bus bars for data centers are expected to yield around 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volumes dropped to 5,278 tons in the quarter, representing a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company plans to expand its capacity from 35,000 to 45,000 tons next year.
orders_capacity.quote: From 35,000 to 45,000 tons. It is not for this year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity for CTC wires is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will be increased to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's manufacturing capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes in the last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized the first round of fundraising at 52 crores, with the money expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans a second tranche of fundraising around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's projections show that its debt will be around 325 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is Rs. 52.25 crores.
The company's working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has filed a joint petition before the NCLT Hyderabad bench for the demerger scheme.
capital_allocation.quote: And the joint petition has been filed before the honorable NCLT Hyderabad bench with respect to the scheme of demerger.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has a GST case put on it due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced trade route disruptions and material shortages in the first two months of the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company notes that there will always be competitive pressures as time goes on.
risks_headwinds.quote: But we have to understand that there will always be competitive pressures all around us as time flies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Copper scrap availability from the Gulf region has suddenly dried up.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping lines carrying scrap from the rest of the world have been diverted, causing delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects its first-quarter volume to be slightly lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Having said that, I do see that in the first quarter, my volume might be slightly lower than the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years (FY27 and FY28).
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to increase its value-added product share to 68-69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we had projected last year that we will slowly keep increasing from the 62% which we had, and reach 68-69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.claim: The government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest 40 crores on capacities and new ventures over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to raise approximately 150 crores in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
